notes: elheraldo.co (Arc Publishing): ONE per-day sitemap gives the whole day - /arc/outboundfeeds/sitemap/{YYYY}-{MM}-{DD}/?outputType=xml, 200 on every day tested (146/142/99/148/101 URLs on 09-25,09-30,10-10,10-20,10-24; 34 by 11:00Z on 10-25), robots.txt allows our UA there and lists only 'latest'+yesterday in its sitemap-index (so the index is no guide: the dated files exist unlisted). All <loc> are /section/ or /section/subsection/+YYYY/MM/DD/slug; regex matched 100% of 1,454 locs over 11 days and 8-10k chars of text per article, no paywall. 92-100% of a day file carries that day's path date; the rest are recirculated old items (a few 2024/2025 URLs on 10-20), filter on the /YYYY/MM/DD/ segment if exact publication date matters.
